title: Summarize what is on sale
prompt: For the products that are not discontinued, return one row with three columns: products, how many there are; units, the total of their stock; and average_price, their average price rounded to 2 decimal places.
hints: Which clause decides the rows the aggregates see?
count, sum and avg can share one SELECT list. Round only the average.
SELECT count(*) AS products, sum(stock) AS units, ROUND(avg(price), 2) AS average_price ... WHERE discontinued = false

wrongAnswers.misconception: Summarizes every product, including the discontinued ones.
Leaves the average with all its decimal places.

feedback: Check each of the three numbers on its own: the filter decides the first two, and rounding decides the third.
